blocks.original: Price Action Zones - The last piece of the puzzle

Every candle on the chart is part ofa PAZ o fone form or another and knowing where price is in relation to these zones gile us a massive edge on the markets. Up until now, we have been taught nearly everything we need to know to be successful traders, PAZs really are

So what is a Price Action Zone? A PAZ is exactly what it says; it •s a zone on your charts that show a distinct type of Price Action! These distinct zones include poles, flags: stacked supply:demand and compression _ Once we are able to accurately determine where these
One great type of PAZ is the space bet-ween two Failure to returns ' (FTR), which is the space in which a flag forms; lees look into this a little further:
